name: accordion-19
description: Customer order history with status badges on each trigger and line items inside.

files.content:
import { ChevronDownIcon, PackageIcon } from "lucide-react" import { Accordion, AccordionContent, AccordionItem, AccordionTrigger, } from "@workspace/ui/components/accordion" import { Badge } from "@workspace/ui/components/badge" import { Button } from "@workspace/ui/components/button" const orders = [ { value: "48213", date: "Nov 9", status: "Shipped", total: 132.5, items: ["Ceramic pour-over set", "Filter papers x100"], }, { value: "47990", date: "Oct 30", status: "Delivered", total: 58.0, items: ["Oak serving board"], }, { value: "47512", date: "Oct 2", status: "Refunded", total: 24.0, items: ["Stoneware mug (Sage)"], }, ] const statusVariant: Record = { Shipped: "default", Delivered: "secondary", Refunded: "destructive", } export default function AccordionOrderHistory() { return ( {orders.map((order) => ( Order #{order.value} Placed {order.date} {order.status}
    {order.items.map((item) => (
  • {item}
    • ))}
Total ${order.total.toFixed(2)}
))} ) }
